posts.author: thecloakgirl
posts.body:
Hello! I've been using RPG Maker since 2017(? I think?) but I've never posted on the forums until now. I came across one of my old projects:
Goodbye In Summer
. It was a little demo I threw together in three days (maybe for a game jam? I don't remember) that I ended up never doing anything with. In fact, I actually have no plans to continue it as I now have other ideas and projects to work on. Sill, I liked the little cat sprites I made and thought others might like them too. So here they are! Comes in three sizes.
Free to use in any commercial or non-commercial project. Credit would be nice, but not required. If you do, please credit me as Tape and Cardboard Productions or as TaCP.
Hope you enjoy!

posts.body: These are awesome. Thank you for sharing them.
